_comment: Cross-SDK GOLDEN fixture for the P2-6 EvaluatorClient (TS dispute/EvaluatorClient.ts + Py dispute/evaluator_client.py). Frozen sources: services/dispute-evaluator/API-CONTRACT.md (wire shapes + handshake), AIP-14 FINAL §4.7 (2/3 verification), the GOLDEN ruling/digest in dispute_golden_vector.json (digest 0x9b477852dd1ddad0105ca5e2a320c6ca72105215985b53878ae12b49eb34e365). Both SDK test suites consume this file byte-identically and MUST recover the SAME signer addresses for every signature. The four test private keys are 0x11..11 / 0x22..22 / 0x33..33 / 0x44..44 (fixedA / fixedB / rotating / unknown).

registry._comment: thirdEvaluator = rotatingPool[uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(disputeId))) % len]. With len=1, the single rotating evaluator is always selected for this disputeId.

signatures._comment: Each is a 65-byte EIP-712 signature over the GOLDEN ruling+domain above. fixedA/fixedB/rotating recover to the registry addresses; unknown recovers to a non-registered address.

quoteResponse._comment: STEP 1 — the HTTP 402 body the server returns from POST /quote. A 402 here is the normal quote success path (not an error envelope).

evaluateSignedResponse._comment: STEP 5 (a) — HTTP 200 body for the SIGNED path. signatures = [fixedA, rotating] => 2 valid evaluators => passes 2/3. SDK re-recovers and does NOT trust evaluators[].
evaluateSignedResponse.reasoning: Deliverable is 4 words vs SLA minimum 200; ruling 1 (requester) at 0.95 confidence.

evaluateProposeDirectlyResponse._comment: STEP 5 (b) — HTTP 200 body for the proposeDirectly path. signatures ALWAYS []. The SDK surfaces the recommendation and NEVER fabricates a signature.

recommendation.rationale: Models split 2:1 across ruling 0/2; no 2/3 supermajority at >= 90%.

evaluateProposeDirectlyResponse.reasoning: Ensemble did not reach 2/3 @ >= 90%; recommend the disputer/proposer call proposeDirectly().

verificationCases._comment: §4.7 verification scenarios the SDK MUST replicate. sigKeys index into signatures{} above. expectValid is the §4.7 result for now=ruling.timestamp (fresh).

twoValidOneUnknown._comment: 2 valid (fixedA + rotating) + 1 unknown => validCount 2 => PASSES (unknown silently ignored).

duplicateCountedOnce._comment: fixedA signed twice + fixedB once => fixedA counted once => validCount 2 => PASSES.

duplicateUnderThreshold._comment: fixedA signed twice only => counted once => validCount 1 => FAILS (< 2).

stale._comment: Fresh-by-count (fixedA+fixedB) but now > timestamp + freshnessSeconds => FAILS the freshness gate.
